subject: Hosted API: narrow p95 window exception request (FinTechCo)
messages:
From: Sana Patel <sana.patel@fintechco.com>
To: diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@fintechco.com
Date: Wed, 10 Sep 2025 10:03:00 -0400
Subject: Question on p95 measurement window for Hosted API

Hi Diego,

Quick question as we're working through our final SLA checklist for production rollout next week. Our payments UX is extremely sensitive to tail latency; our infra team has noticed recurring short-lived p95 spikes that correlate with a nightly reconciliation batch (2–3 minutes long) hitting our upstreams. Those spikes are inflating our p95 when measured on the standard rolling 1-minute windows and would technically breach the hosted API p95 commitment.

Rather than re-architect the batch this week, is Redwood willing to consider a temporary exception/carve-out for the EU region where p95 is measured over a slightly larger aggregation window for scheduled batch periods? Something like allowing a 5-minute measurement window during the nightly job or excluding the known maintenance window for 30 days would be ideal.

Appreciate a quick confirmation — procurement needs this written for our SSO and risk committee review.

Thanks,
Sana Patel
Head of Platform, FinTechCo
Sana.patel@fintechco.com

Attachments: none
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sana Patel <sana.patel@fintechco.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 10 Sep 2025 12:18:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Question on p95 measurement window for Hosted API

Hi Sana — thanks for the detail; good context.

Short answer: yes, we can propose a controlled, temporary exception rather than forcing a last-minute infra change on your side. To make it safe for both teams I propose we: 
- Define a 30-day temporary exception specific to the EU region and the quoted endpoint(s).
- Temporarily measure p95 as a 5-minute rolling aggregation during the documented nightly batch window (we'll need the exact cron/time range).
- Add a transient carve-out so that scheduled maintenance windows are excluded from the rolling-window calculation.

Operational considerations:
- We'll require a Canary routing policy (small percent of traffic to the standard variant) so we can validate correctness without global risk.
- We'll add extra tracing on the affected routes and share latency exports daily for the 30-day trial.
- Pricing: we can offer a nominal one-time credit if the exception introduces material increased costs on our side (I can get Ben to scope this).

Looping in Marissa (AM lead) and Ben (Account Exec) to draft the formal addendum and the DocuSign. Can you confirm the nightly job window (TZ and start/end) and whether there are any other scheduled spikes in the EU region?

Cheers,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: none
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 09:07:00 -04:00
Subject: RE: Hosted API: narrow p95 window exception request (FinTechCo)

Diego / Ben — drafting language below for the addendum we can present to FinTechCo. I attached a redline and a short export of baseline latency for the last 30 days.

Proposed temporary addendum (summary):
- Scope: EU-hosted API routes listed in Appendix A (we'll enumerate the path prefixes).
- Standard commitments: p50 <= 75ms, p95 <= 300ms measured on 1-minute rolling windows aggregated daily.
- Temporary exception: For scheduled nightly reconciliation windows provided by FinTechCo (max 3 minutes per occurrence), p95 will be measured using a 5-minute rolling aggregation for those time windows only, for a trial period of 30 calendar days starting on the signed effective date. During the trial we will also: 
  * Enable canary routing (5% traffic) to the primary model variant for continuous validation.
  * Export hourly latency reports to FinTechCo SRE and Redwood account team.
  * Allow up to two transient carve-outs if FinTechCo identifies additional scheduled jobs during the 30-day trial.
- Termination / rollback: If production quality degrades (measured via our quality signals) we reserve the right to pause the exception and engage remediation; we'll provide 24-hour notice before pausing.
- Commercial: No change to monthly usage rates; Redwood will issue a one-time credit up to $4,000 if the exception increases resource consumption beyond an agreed threshold (TBD in schedule).

Notes: I attached SLA_addendum_draft_v1.pdf (redline) and latency-metrics-export.csv. Ben — can you put the credit threshold language in a separate commercial clause and include a DocuSign envelope?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachments:
- SLA_addendum_draft_v1.pdf (redline)
- latency-metrics-export.csv (baseline percentiles)
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sana Patel <sana.patel@fintechco.com>, procurement@fintechco.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 14:42:00 -04:00
Subject: RE: Hosted API: narrow p95 window exception request (FinTechCo)

Hi Sana — following up with the formal materials.

Attached is the SLA addendum (redline) capturing the temporary p95 measurement-window exception for the EU routes, plus the baseline export we discussed. Key points:
- Trial duration: 30 days from signed effective date.
- Measurement change: p95 measured as a 5-minute rolling aggregation only during the specified nightly reconciliation window (you'll confirm exact times).
- Canary: 5% routing to validate correctness and risk-control.
- Commercial: we committed to the one-time credit clause; Ben will include the exact threshold in the DocuSign envelope.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/xxxxx/FinTechCo-SLA (also attached as RDW-DocuSign-link.txt)

If that matches your expectations, please sign the addendum and we'll schedule the canary for the first maintenance window following confirmation. Happy to hop on 15 minutes if you want to walk through the redline.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
